## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-juan late-Míng anthology of brief biographical notices and enlightenment-occasion records for laypeople of recognised Chán attainment — the "Collected [Records of the] Formerly-Awakened." Compiled by the lay editor Táo Míngqián.

**Abstract**

A compact lay-practitioner anthology in the same genre as [朱時恩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%B1%E6%99%82%E6%81%A9) Zhū Shí'ēn's *Jūshì fēndēng lù* ([KR6q0039](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0039)), selecting exemplary lay Chán figures from earlier lamp records and recorded-sayings literature and presenting them in condensed form for the late-Míng lay-Buddhist reading market.
